output_list.reason: The 'distributeFUD' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check 'sufficientFunds && !overflowed' is meant to prevent overflow, but it is flawed. The 'sufficientFunds' check is correct, but the '!overflowed' part is redundant, because overflow is the default state in Solidity. Hence, it is safe to transfer tokens to a user without checking overflow.
